mapper.sql: attachment_id, project_id, approval_id, version_no, section_code, file_name, file_url, file_size, file_ext, mime_type, description, upload_by, upload_time
mapper.select: select from pm_project_initiation_attachment where project_id = #{projectId} and approval_id is null and section_code = #{sectionCode} order by upload_time, attachment_id

select from pm_project_initiation_attachment where project_id = #{projectId} and approval_id = (select a.approval_id from pm_project_initiation_approval a where a.project_id = #{projectId} and a.status = 'APPROVED' order by a.version_no desc limit 1) and section_code = #{sectionCode} order by upload_time, attachment_id
mapper.insert: insert into pm_project_initiation_attachment( project_id, approval_id, version_no, section_code, file_name, file_url, file_size, file_ext, mime_type, description, upload_by, upload_time ) values ( #{projectId}, null, 0, #{sectionCode}, #{fileName}, #{fileUrl}, #{fileSize}, #{fileExt}, #{mimeType}, #{description}, #{uploadBy}, sysdate() )

insert into pm_project_initiation_attachment( project_id, approval_id, version_no, section_code, file_name, file_url, file_size, file_ext, mime_type, description, upload_by, upload_time ) select project_id, null, #{versionNo}, section_code, file_name, file_url, file_size, file_ext, mime_type, description, upload_by, upload_time from pm_project_initiation_attachment where approval_id = #{approvalId}
mapper.delete: delete from pm_project_initiation_attachment where project_id = #{projectId} and attachment_id = #{attachmentId} and approval_id is null
